scope: Worldwide official-source leads for organic soy products produced by mechanical pressing, expeller pressing, extrusion-expelling, or cold pressing. This file includes the previous Tier-A companies already seeded in the app.
qualityRule: A company is listed under verifiedCompanies only when an official company page or official product page supports organic soy activity plus mechanical/expeller/cold-press evidence, or the previous Tier-A seed already contained that verified evidence. Candidates without explicit organic plus mechanical/expeller evidence are kept under excludedOrNeedsFollowUp.

verifiedCompanies.buyingEvidence: Official product page offers organic soybean press cake, references Regulation (EU) 2018/848 and FR-BIO-10, and describes mechanical cold pressing with solvent-free processing.
verifiedCompanies.potentialContactPoint: Purchasing Manager / Responsable Achats Matieres Premieres / Directeur Approvisionnement

verifiedCompanies.buyingEvidence: Official page confirms work with organic soy and states that soybean press cake from pressing is used in organic poultry and cattle feed.
verifiedCompanies.potentialContactPoint: Responsable Negoce / Acheteur Matieres Premieres Bio / Responsable Approvisionnement

verifiedCompanies.buyingEvidence: Official product information says organic soybeans are mechanically processed, oil is removed by cold pressing, and the output is Bio-Sojakuchen.
verifiedCompanies.potentialContactPoint: Rohstoffeinkauf / Leiter Einkauf / Procurement Manager Bio-Rohstoffe

verifiedCompanies.buyingEvidence: Official brand page presents organic soybean cake for organic feed and describes the process as mechanical cooking and pressing without chemical products.
verifiedCompanies.potentialContactPoint: Responsable Achats Matieres Premieres / Procurement Manager - Nutrition Animale

verifiedCompanies.buyingEvidence: Official product page offers certified organic soybean cake or meal obtained through soybean pressing and intended as a high-protein animal feed ingredient.
verifiedCompanies.potentialContactPoint: Responsabile Acquisti / Raw Materials Buyer / Direttore Commerciale

verifiedCompanies.buyingEvidence: Official feed page covers soy and rapeseed press cake and feed oils, cold pressing, and organic oilseed processing.
verifiedCompanies.potentialContactPoint: Rohstoffeinkauf / Betriebsleitung Olmuhle / Einkauf Bio-Olsaaten

verifiedCompanies.buyingEvidence: Official product page identifies the composition as organic soy cake, explicitly mechanically pressed, without solvents, and not extraction meal.
verifiedCompanies.potentialContactPoint: Einkauf Futtermittel / Rohstoffeinkauf / Produktmanagement Tierernahrung

verifiedCompanies.buyingEvidence: Official product page lists Organic Expeller Soybean Meal for organic and chemical-free livestock diets. The company states HACCP and ISO9001:2015 status and Australian Certified Organic (ACO) plus USDA NOP compliance.
verifiedCompanies.potentialContactPoint: Procurement Manager / Raw Materials Buyer / Nutrition and Formulation Manager

verifiedCompanies.buyingEvidence: Official protein-meals page says Mara produces extruded and expelled products and offers protein meals in organic and conventional form. Its defatted and full-fat soybean meals are described as made from Australian soybeans through mechanical, chemical-free processing.
verifiedCompanies.potentialContactPoint: Purchasing Manager / Sales and Supply Manager / Protein Meals Commercial Manager

verifiedCompanies.buyingEvidence: Official Hyfeed page says the Toowoomba mill is ACO-certified to manufacture organic non-GMO full-fat soybean meal and expeller soybean meal onsite. It also states PBA Feeds supplies full-fat soybean meal, expeller soybean meal, soybean oil, expeller canola meal and canola oil made onsite.
verifiedCompanies.potentialContactPoint: Purchasing Manager / Mill Manager / Feed Ingredients Buyer

verifiedCompanies.buyingEvidence: Official products page says Soyl works only with organic soybeans from certified organic suppliers and processes them into organic soybean oil and organic soybean expellers. The expellers are used in the animal feed industry and held in strategic stock.
verifiedCompanies.potentialContactPoint: Purchasing Manager / Sales Manager Organic Soy / Raw Materials Buyer

verifiedCompanies.buyingEvidence: Official Ennsdorf page describes a certified organic expeller press oilseed crushing plant that handles soybean seed and produces organic oils and organic press cakes. It positions press cake as protein feed for agriculture.
verifiedCompanies.potentialContactPoint: Feedstuff Sales / Raw Materials Procurement / Oil Mill Operations Manager

verifiedCompanies.buyingEvidence: Official organic feed page says FODER uses certified organic soybeans to make BIO-Sojakuchen. The soybeans are extruded and then organic soybean oil is obtained with mechanical pressing equipment, with no chemical compounds used at any stage.
verifiedCompanies.potentialContactPoint: Rohstoffeinkauf / Procurement Manager Organic Feed / Sales Manager Bio-Futtermittel

verifiedCompanies.buyingEvidence: Official Bio-Sojakuchen page says organic soy cakes are obtained by a mechanical cold process and lists related organic soy products including organic soy oil, organic soy texturization, and organic soy extrusion.
verifiedCompanies.potentialContactPoint: Responsabile Acquisti / Procurement Manager Bio Soy / Business Development Agribio

verifiedCompanies.buyingEvidence: Official organic soybean oil page says the facility is 100 percent organic and that the process used to make soybean meal is mechanical, pressing oil naturally rather than using solvents such as hexane.
verifiedCompanies.potentialContactPoint: Procurement Manager / Organic Soybean Buyer / Ingredient Sales Manager

verifiedCompanies.buyingEvidence: Official product standards page says Majestic buys USDA #2 organic soybeans, sells high-protein organic soybean meal, and produces expeller-pressed crude organic soybean oil. The page also states Majestic Milling is certified organic by EcoCert USA.
verifiedCompanies.potentialContactPoint: Raw Materials Buyer / Procurement Manager / Organic Soybean Meal Sales

verifiedCompanies.buyingEvidence: Official expeller-pressed page says Boyd produces 100 percent expeller-pressed products using heat and pressure rather than chemicals, eliminates solvents from oil extraction, and offers hexane-free soybean meals for food and feed formulations while maintaining organic and non-GMO production standards.
verifiedCompanies.potentialContactPoint: Procurement Manager / Ingredient Sales Manager / Supply Team

verifiedCompanies.buyingEvidence: Official homepage says Sheppard Grain mechanically extrudes soybean meal, operates soybean roasting, serves the animal-feed industry, and brokers organic commodities. The site presents organic soybean meal and soybean oil products in its page title.
verifiedCompanies.potentialContactPoint: Procurement Manager / Organic Commodity Broker / Sales Manager

verifiedCompanies.buyingEvidence: Official products page says CapRock specializes in grains, meals, and oils that meet organic certification standards, including domestic expelled soybean meal and import expelled soybean meal. The about page states all facilities are certified organic.
verifiedCompanies.potentialContactPoint: Organic Feed Ingredients Buyer / Procurement Manager / Trading Desk

verifiedCompanies.buyingEvidence: Official product page describes organic soybean meal made from organic soybean seed, with further oil extraction by screw press expeller. It says the product is free from hexane or petrochemical products and lists NOP, COR, and EU certified organic specifications.
verifiedCompanies.potentialContactPoint: Export Manager / Raw Materials Procurement / Sales Manager Organic Soybean Meal

verifiedCompanies.buyingEvidence: Official site lists organic soybean seeds, organic raw soybean oil obtained by mechanical extraction by pressing, and organic soybean expeller processed using a continuous press. The site describes export activity from South America to North America, Canada, Europe, and Mexico.
verifiedCompanies.potentialContactPoint: Export Manager / Procurement Manager / Organic Commodities Trader

verifiedCompanies.buyingEvidence: Official product page lists Organic Extruded Soybean Meal and Organic Soy Meal made from non-GMO and organic Chinese soybeans. The same page states Organic Soy Meal is processed through traditional low-temperature pressing technology, and the company publishes export contact emails.
verifiedCompanies.potentialContactPoint: Export Manager / Organic Soy Products Sales / Raw Materials Sales

verifiedCompanies.buyingEvidence: Official product page says organic soybean meal is derived from organically grown GMO-free soybeans and mechanically processed. It also states the extraction process is completely non-chemical and does not involve harmful chemicals like hexane.
verifiedCompanies.potentialContactPoint: Export Sales Manager / Organic Soybean Meal Sales / Procurement Manager

verifiedCompanies.buyingEvidence: Official homepage says Pragati Organics specializes in feed ingredient supply and grain merchandising and manufactures Organic Soybean Meal through extrusion and expeller process for poultry, dairy and swine. The contact email is present on the site but is obfuscated by the website renderer, so it is not stored as a plaintext email here.
verifiedCompanies.potentialContactPoint: Export Sales Manager / Organic Soybean Meal Sales / Feed Ingredients Manager

verifiedCompanies.buyingEvidence: Official organic soybean processing page lists organic soya meal and an extruder-based plant with FSSAI, APEDA, GMP-PLUS, NPOP and NOP certifications. The described process sends extruded material through an expeller to separate crude oil and soya oil cake, and the page states the process is chemical-free.
verifiedCompanies.potentialContactPoint: Export Manager / Organic Soybean Processing Sales / Raw Materials Buyer
